Misconception.description: The error occurs when students divide the numerators and ignore the denominators, treating division like repeated subtraction. This leads to accuracy issues in solving.
Misconception.title: Dividing Numerators Only

Misconception.description: Division problems are misinterpreted as multiplication due to contextual confusion. Misreads lead to wrong problem setup and results.
Misconception.title: Incorrect Interpretation as Multiplication

Misconception.description: Students reverse the order of division leading to incorrect results. They confuse division direction with multiplication commutativity, applying the wrong order.
Misconception.title: Reversed Division Order

Misconception.description: Students fail to invert the second fraction before multiplying. They may think the operation works like multiplication without adjustment. This error leads to an incorrect quotient.
Misconception.title: Did Not Flip Second Fraction
